measurements.note: A local observation recorded ordinary resident abort signals at -31.811 to 213.687 ms relative to child CLI close; negative means the poll aborted before the command process exited. These are individual samples, not latency bounds or production benchmarks.

limitations: The cadence is a scheduling interval, not a wall-clock maximum; storage reads and event-loop delay add latency
File revision hints still enumerate retained filenames and check metadata; periodic authoritative checks retain full original read/hash costs
Cancellation stops the observation wait; a noncooperative raw source or already-pending storage read may finish later under its owning host
The watcher covers active resident/mission source polls and does not add a global cross-process cancellation bus for unrelated model/tool execution
